title: Grading Cards Near Me (2026)
verdict: Grading cards near me is possible in only a few places, and AGS is one grader that accepts in-person drop-offs at select locations as well as mail.

If you live near a major card show, check which graders are taking submissions there. Otherwise the fastest route is direct mail to a grader with a short turnaround, which matters more than how far away the lab is.

sections.h: Four ways to get cards graded locally
list: Drop them off. AGS accepts in-person drop-offs at select locations, including secure intake at its headquarters at 727 Page Ave, Staten Island, New York. Confirm with AGS first.
Use a card shop. The shop ships your cards to a grading company and adds a handling fee. Ask which grader, which tier and the full price.
Mail them to a grader yourself. This is how most cards are graded. AGS returns standard orders in 20 business days or less.
Go to a card show. Large shows often have graders accepting submissions, and some grade on site at premium prices.
Confirm with AGS that the location is taking drop-offs and when.
Fill out the submission form online first.
Bring the cards in penny sleeves and card savers, in the order listed on the form.
Keep your order number. You can follow the order in the dashboard afterward.

ranking.fit: Collectors who want one flat $15 price and a 14-day turnaround.

why: You are not limited to the mailbox. AGS lists in-person drop-off at select locations and secure intake at its Staten Island headquarters, and it operates satellite labs. Ask AGS which site is taking cards before you set out.

The terms are easy. There is no minimum submission, no membership and no contract, and AGS does not charge until the cards are graded and ready to ship. New customers get 20% off a first order with code AGSNEW20.

One price covers everything. $18 buys the scan, the grade, eight subgrades, the report and the slab, for any card at any value. Orders of 30 or more TCG cards pay $15 a card on the standard bulk tier.

faq.q: Is there a place for grading cards near me?
faq.a: Grading is done in central labs, so near me usually means by mail. AGS returns mail-in orders in 20 business days or less and takes in-person drop-offs at select locations.

faq.q: Can I get cards graded at a card show?
faq.a: Sometimes. Large graders take submissions at big shows, and a few grade on site at premium prices. AGS's scanner is compact enough for on-site grading. Check the show's exhibitor list and each grader's schedule.

faq.q: Is mailing cards for grading safe?
faq.a: Yes, if you pack them properly and use a tracked, insured service. AGS returns cards with tracking and offers optional insurance on the return shipment.

faq.q: Is AGS a legitimate grading company?
faq.a: Yes. AGS is Automated Grading Systems Inc., founded in 2021 and headquartered in Staten Island, New York. It publishes a live population report and a cert lookup, and says it ranked third in TCG grading volume in 2026.

faq.q: Can I submit from outside the United States?
faq.a: Yes. AGS accepts international shipments and runs a UK site. Check customs and insurance on your side before you ship.
